scope: Current Singles and Doubles usage data only; never changes localization, saved builds, or Calc species.

entries.evidence: The provider's Floette artwork, Mega form, and six displayed stats identify Eternal Flower Floette. Its stats match Floette-Eternal at level 50, 31 IVs, 0 EVs and a neutral nature, not ordinary Floette. These values verify identity only and are never used as calculation inputs.

nativeTransition.evidence: floette retains historical CSVs through 2026-09-11 with no Current battle summary or CSV paths. floetteeternal has CSVs from 2026-09-12 onward and Current Singles/Doubles summaries and CSV paths. Both retain the verified identity stats.
nativeTransition.policy: Exclude a verified history-only legacy record when a unique native record has Current data. Keep the legacy mapping for legacy-only API responses and published v1 payloads.

entries.reviewWhen: Stop and review if legacy identity stats change, either ID is duplicated, or both legacy and native IDs have Current data. An explicit floetteeternal entry alone needs no remapping.
